note: The hub as the designer locked it, inside out. Every value carries its status word and source: DECIDED (the designer), REGISTER (carried from presets/electromagnets-RA.json), DESIGN / PROPOSED (sized or proposed here, the designer's to accept), ESTIMATE, OPEN (a placeholder [RH] until the designer sets it). Read by sim/hub_locked.py and sim/hub_rings_build.py.

value: AH cores with their coils (on the z axis, top and bottom)
retainer (holds the vessel, the rings and the AH)
shaft (the same shaft top and bottom, one half per side)
pumps (each shaft half carries its side's electrostatic and magnetic pump, symmetric)

vessel_wall.source: designer, 2026-10-09 (shell stress about 0.8 MPa under vacuum)

vessel_resistivity.source: borosilicate at 25 C, datasheet-class (about 1e15 ohm cm); falls steeply with temperature

value.role: the field's electrodes: the rings outside the glass (not electrodes inside the vacuum)
value.where: on the vessel's outer surface, one on each hemisphere, mirror-symmetric about the equator
value.form: prototype: bands of 0.1 mm annealed copper foil on the glass (cut as gores to fit the sphere, overlapped and soldered), each edge beaded with a soldered copper wire ring; a fired-on coating later (its edges beaded or graded the same way)
value.supply: DC, the symmetric supply: ring A on its own 2-stage Cockcroft-Walton chain from the shaft on node 1 (-15.0 kV), ring B on the mirror chain on node 4 (+15.0 kV); 29.9 kV across, the null at the shaft's potential; storage 100 pF; no Dk, no C_A

rings.status: DECIDED (rings outside the glass; copper foil with rounded edges for the prototype; the symmetric supply) / DESIGN (edges, beads: sim/hub_rings_build.py)
rings.source: designer, 2026-10-09 (the rings; then the symmetric supply, 'if it pumps against the core centre, yes'); the design from sim/hub-rings-build-findings.md: the most field at the null with the gap holding the interface rating along the glass and both beads the gel's rating (ratings below), in the mirror family. Supersedes the asymmetric 25.75-57.7 deg on ring B's 2 stages and Dk (6.93 kV/cm), and the lock-down's 20-53 deg on three stages, whose edges were not checked. Drawing: docs/drawings/DCCREG-HUB-201; design: docs/rings-design.md.
rings.tag: [RH] the ratings; [IR] the field solves (a modelling choice); [OC] the electrostatics they solve

ratings.status: DESIGN (the record's) / OPEN until the bench qualifies them
ratings.source: interface: the average DC along the glass between the rings, under the gel and the retainer; gel: the peak DC field at a bead in void-free silicone gel, about a third of its short-term strength. The bench test qualifies both (docs/bench-test-rings.md phase 1); they set the stages (sim/hub-rings-build-findings.md).

value.dominated_by: the multiplier's diodes and capacitors and the HV assembly's surface; the rings' own insulation leaks about a thousand times less

rings_leakage.source: sim/hub_rings_build.py LEAKAGE (datasheet-class parts); replaces the 10 G placeholder

value.where: on the z axis, top and bottom of the vessel

coil.window: variant (a)'s: 2 layers of 1.6 mm pitch on the former

value.potential: the coil's cold end; the core tied to it (about the shaft's potential)

AH.source: designer, 2026-10-08; presets/electromagnets-RA.json AH_rod, AH_former, AH_variants (a); sim/magnetic_doubler.py AH r160

value.between: the vessel's pole and the core's tip

AH_seat.source: presets/electromagnets-RA.json (sim/em_solids.py RA_seat); now 5.7 mm with the 50 mm vessel

value.holds: the vessel, the rings, the AH cores and coils
value.material: PEEK, unfilled (natural grade; no carbon or glass fill), machined from annealed stock
value.pocket: 0.5 mm over the glass with grooves for the rings' beads, filled with the interface filler
value.alternative: PEI (Ultem 1000), eps 3.15: higher resistivity and strength, slower to settle, more moisture

retainer.source: designer, 2026-10-08 (role), 2026-10-09 (accepted PEEK, the gel and the G10 coupler); the material from sim/hub-rings-build-findings.md: non-magnetic and non-conducting (no effect on the AH), low eps (the field at the null moves under 1 % from eps 2.1 to 4.7), low moisture, machines and holds size; the dimensions a placeholder that encloses the AH coils

value.material: silicone gel, two-part, degassed and vacuum-cast into the retainer's pocket
value.role: fills the glass-retainer interface without voids, beds the beads, and takes the PEEK-glass expansion mismatch

interface_filler.source: sim/hub-rings-build-findings.md; accepted by the designer 2026-10-09; eps datasheet-class

value.material: G10, outside the retainer (not against the glass or the rings)
value.shape: OPEN (the tube's bicone is a placeholder)

shaft_coupler.status: DECIDED (role; G10 outside the PEEK: the designer, 2026-10-09) / OPEN (shape, dimensions)
shaft_coupler.source: designer, 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09; G10's fibres would give a tracking path at the rings, so PEEK takes the inside

value.layout: the same shaft top and bottom, one half per side

shaft.status: DECIDED (layout, the flanges outside the vessel, outboard of the AH) / REGISTER (d)
shaft.source: designer, 2026-10-08 / 2026-10-09 ('the AH flanges sit outside the vessel'; the 160-turn coil kept); presets/electromagnets-RA.json shaft (d 30, non-magnetic tip); sim/stack_sizing.py FLANGE_R / FLANGE_T. The tube layout still carries the 120 mm placeholder hub: refreshing it puts the flanges at |z| 72 and grows the tube by about 24 mm.

pumps.value: symmetric top and bottom: each shaft half carries its side's electrostatic stack and magnetic (utron) group (the tube layout's sides A / B)

value: the ratings: the interface along the glass and the gel at the beads (they set the stages: bench test phase 1)
each ring's leakage (100 G estimate: bench test phase 2)
the retainer's and coupler's dimensions; the rings' leads through them
the AH ends facing the polar beads (the coil's end turns and former: rounded or capped); the AH seat's length, which sets how near the pole the bands may start
the fired-on coating's edges (beaded, or graded by a resistive layer toward the pole)
the tube layout and its 3-D model still carry the 120 mm placeholder hub (sim/stack_sizing.py hub_mm, sim/tube_geometry.py)
